description: This file defines the feature for deleting comments within a web application, including the command, validation, and handler for executing the delete operation associated with a specific article identified by its slug.

classes.name: Delete
classes.description: Encapsulates functionality for deleting a comment from an article, including the command, validator, and handler classes.

methods.name: CommandValidator
methods.description: Validates that the Slug property of the command is not null or empty.

methods.name: QueryHandler
methods.description: Handles the deletion of a comment by locating the related article and comment, removing the comment, and saving changes to the database.
